summary: Frontend test of redesigned HomePage (desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844). All 8 requested features PASS. Hero renders correctly, no console/page errors. The 'Get Instant Quote' button goes to #calculator. Slider pricing is correct: 5->$35, 8->$56 (Coffee Visit at $7/drink), 9/25->Small $300, 26/50/60->Medium $500. Package prices match GET /api/event-settings (visit $7, small $300, medium $500). All 7 book buttons go to /book-event, and the street link goes to /menu. All 4 event images load, including Sports & Community. The shop status badge shows online. Mobile: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390), the footer sits fully above the 73px bottom nav, and hero/CTA buttons are full width (358px).

issues: The logo's dark brown 'beso' text is hard to see on the #1A1A1A footer background. Consider a light logo variant or a light pill behind the logo.

pb-20 on the root homepage div leaves an empty beige strip of about 100px under the dark footer, above the bottom nav. Consider moving the padding into the footer, or making the root background dark at the bottom.
At 51-60 guests the calculator still shows 'Medium Event $500', but medium is described as 25-50 people and the slider label says 60+. Consider showing 'Custom Quote / Contact us' when guests > 50.
how-it-works-book-button is not full width on mobile (284px, centered) while other CTAs are full width. Minor inconsistency.

action_items: Optional: show a custom quote in the calculator when guests > 50
Optional: improve footer logo contrast on the dark background
Optional: remove the beige gap under the footer on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx: the axios event-settings fetch swallows errors silently (catch(() => {})). Hardcoded fallback prices are acceptable, but there is no loading state, so on slow networks the defaults may briefly show before admin values.
Boundary: 9 guests maps to Small Event, while the visit range is '5-8 drinks' and small is '10-25'. The behavior is acceptable but undocumented.
Link wrapping Button (<a><button>) is invalid nested interactive HTML. Prefer Button asChild with Link.
seed_data_creation: none; admin event settings not modified
context_for_next_testing_agent: HomePage verified on desktop and mobile. The slider is set via the native value setter plus an input event. Current event-settings: visit $7/drink, small $300, medium $500, all enabled.
